title: Running only to the familiar bush
literal_meaning: The lizard’s dash is to the siju bush!
explanation: The source uses the short dash to mock a narrow range of thought. Much motion may still lead only to a familiar answer.
meaning_odia: ବହୁତ ଧାଁଧପଡ଼ କଲେ ବି ଚିନ୍ତା ସେହି ସୀମିତ ଗଣ୍ଡି ଭିତରେ ରହିଯାଏ।
usage_example: A planning group holds many meetings but considers only the same old option. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Siju is retained as the plant name. This is a figurative reading, not a zoological claim or a judgment of fixed intelligence.
